bagPolicy.summary: The arena FAQ says there is no general bag ban, but each event may publish its own bag requirements.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The venue recommends public transport; drivers can use area car parks but event traffic can be heavy.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Guests with reduced mobility can use the area in front of Quality Hotel near Entrance Hx for pickup and drop-off. Follow signs for the hotel.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Restaurants, bars and kiosks sell food and drinks at the arena.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Wheelchair places may be booked on the concert listing; accessible parking is in Mall of Scandinavia and Arenagaraget.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: No. Once you've entered and leave, you can't come back in, because your ticket has already been used.

ticketPickup.summary: Strawberry Arena's ticket counter is next to entrance A and is generally open during events, where you can buy and pick up tickets if any remain. Phone tickets can be scanned as long as the screen is undamaged, and Mobile ID tickets require the app.

gates.summary: Scan your ticket from the Stockholm Live app at the entrance, and charge your phone before you arrive. If your ticket won't scan, the ticketing office can help; Strawberry Arena's ticket counter is next to entrance A. Door times vary by event, so check your event page.
